title_zh: 城市是否应限制私家车
prompt:
Some people think that private car ownership in city centres should be discouraged, while others believe that how people travel is a personal choice.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
outline_hint: Paraphrase the debate and preview your view.
View A: reasons to discourage cars (air, space, safety, noise).
View B: reasons to leave the choice to individuals (rural links, mobility, cost of transit).
Your position: which measures you would prioritise and why.
